name: Jiangsu Jiangyin Rural Commercial Bank Co.,LTD.
summary: Jiangsu Jiangyin Rural Commercial Bank Co.,LTD. provides various personal and corporate banking products and services in China. The company operates through Corporate Business, Personal Business, Treasury Business, and others segments. It offers fixed, current, smart, notice, time, and demand deposits, as well as deposit certificates; gold, mortgage, and personal business and consumption loans; business operating, project, syndicated, agricultural, fund pool, auction, commercial property, revolving, technology, and green energy loans; and corporate finance.
